PL 15707 - 868 (03/2026)
An Act to amend the Inland Revenue 
Act, No. 24 of 2017
BE it enacted by the Parliament of the Democratic Socialist 
Republic of Sri Lanka as follows: -
1. (1) This Act may be cited as the Inland Revenue 
(Amendment) Act, No. 11 of 2026.
(2) The provisions of this Act, other than the provisions 
of sections referred to in subsection (3) of this section, shall 
come into operation on the date on which the Bill becomes 
an Act of Parliament.
(3) The provisions of this Act specified in Column I of 
the Table below which amend the provisions of the Inland 
Revenue Act, No. 24 of 2017 (hereinafter referred to as the 
“principal enactment”) specified in Column II of that Table, 
shall come into operation or be deemed to have come into 
operation, as the case may be, on the respective dates as 
specified in Column III of that Table.
